_meta.note: Moon phases pre-computed for IST (India): new / first quarter / full / last quarter. Phases are astronomical instants — the same worldwide; the date column is each instant mapped to IST. New moon = Amavasya, full moon = Purnima (these are precise instants, distinct from the same-named tithis, which are ~24h windows). For another timezone, build a table at runtime with buildMoonPhasesTable. Times are ISO UTC. Each entry carries both en and hi text.
